title: fix(pm): the relay's adding ops refuse the PR-vs-issue state-label rule, and pm labels match case-insensitively
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xWi79fxRons6ki5r3iaB51c)_

Fixes #31253

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates --tier` reads no path-derived model mandate for this diff. Any mandate above the thread's would be waived by the maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03). The dispatching seat (domain:skills#3) runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：fleet-write 的 `dispatch.mjs` 在发送前对三个加标签入口（`pr_create`、`issue_create`、`labels_add`）执行 PR/issue 状态标签规则：六个状态标签不上 PR，`pm:awaiting-merge` 不上 issue。规则与拒绝文案直接调用 `label-write.mjs` 的 `refuseKindLabels` / `readTargetKind`，不复述。`label-write.mjs` 的 `refuseTwoStates` 与种类拒绝改为大小写不敏感（`labelKey`）。
- 为什么改：PR #31250 只在 label-write 这一道门执行规则；relay 自己的加标签入口绕过它，且两道门都按大小写精确比较，而 GitHub 标签名不分大小写，`Needs-User-Decision` 能绕过检查（#31253，#31250 契约复审 S1/N1）。
- 风险与回滚：只动两个脚本，无 skill 行、无 validate/execute 改动、无 ratchet 上调；拒绝发生在任何写之前，整个 actions 文件一笔都不发；移除标签从不拒绝；不发版（`skip-changeset`）；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`dispatch.mjs` 头部新节「The kind rule」、`kindRuleRows` / `readLabelTargetKinds`、`main` 里两处调用；`label-write.mjs` 的 `labelKey`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --self-test`（349 例，新电池 18 例）；`node scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --self-test`（171 例）。
- 需要你做的：无。`check-governed-merges --test`（两个路径，+247/-14）读数为「NOT governed」，即普通队列落地，不是工单预期的 Tier S；席位契约复审 PASS 后由席位落地。

## What changes

### `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`

- `kindRuleRows(actions)` (pure) walks the three adding ops (`RETIRED_LANE_REWRITE_OPS`, the list the retired-lane rewrite already uses; `labels_remove` is not in it). A create names its own kind (`pr_create` is a pull request, `issue_create` an issue), so it is judged with `refuseKindLabels({ kind, add: labels })` and no read. A `labels_add` goes to the read list only when `refuseKindLabels({ kind: null, add })` is non-null, which is exactly "it adds a label the rule governs" — the predicate is asked, not restated.
- `readLabelTargetKinds(reads, …)` does the read (below) and judges it with `refuseKindLabels`.
- `main`: the create refusal runs right after the lane rewrite, before the session and the packer (usage 2, the rule quoted). The `labels_add` read runs after the packer and before the dry-run exit, beside the existing trailer-signed `issue_patch` read, sharing its token check and proxy re-exec. Any refusal returns before `sendFleetWrite`, so nothing in the whole actions file is sent.
- Header: a new section 「The kind rule」, and the exit-code lines for 2 and 3 name the new refusals.

### `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`

- New export `labelKey(label)` (lower-cases a string). `refuseTwoStates` and `refuseKindLabels` compare the vocabulary through it.
- A refusal whose add was spelled differently names it as written, e.g. "GitHub matches label names case-insensitively: `Needs-User-Decision` is `needs-user-decision`."
- The header's 「The kind rule」 section says both refusals are case-insensitive and that dispatch.mjs asks the same `refuseKindLabels`.

Sample refusal (dry run, no network):

```
fleet-write/dispatch: REFUSED — action 1 (pr_create): `needs-user-decision` is a pm card STATE and its target is a pull request — .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md: its 状态模型 lists the six states as 「issue 上的信号」 and says 「`pm:awaiting-merge` 只挂 PR、不入六态」, and of `needs-user-decision` 「只挂决策卡(issue)、⛔ 永不挂 PR」 — so a PR waiting on the maintainer carries `pm:awaiting-merge` instead; removing a label is never refused. GitHub matches label names case-insensitively: `Needs-User-Decision` is `needs-user-decision`.
fleet-write/dispatch: nothing was sent.
```

## How `labels_add` learns the kind

Before this PR, dispatch.mjs read no `labels_add` target. It read a target only for a trailer-signed `issue_patch` body (`readPullRequestTargets`).

Now a `labels_add` whose labels include one of the seven governed labels (any case) costs **one extra `GET /repos/{repo}/issues/{issue}`** per distinct number. An ungoverned `labels_add` (e.g. `tooling`) and every `labels_remove` read nothing. The answer is asked by label-write's own `readTargetKind`, so `pull_request` and `html_url` must agree, as in label-write's step ①. The read happens after the packer and before the dry-run exit, so a dry run refuses what a send would. Outcomes:

| Read | Verdict | Exit |
|---|---|---|
| 200, kind on which the labels are legal | pass, said on stderr | continues |
| 200, wrong kind | refused, rule quoted | 2 |
| 200, `pull_request` and `html_url` disagree | refused "rather than guessed" (label-write's null-kind sentence) | 2 |
| any other status, or no answer | PREREQUISITE NOT MET, rule quoted | 3 |
| no `GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GH_TOKEN` | PREREQUISITE NOT MET before any request | 3 |

Exit 2 is the code dispatch already uses for a refusal before transport. Exit 3 for an unread target follows dispatch's own existing rule for the `issue_patch` read. (label-write splits a failed card read into 3 or 5 by status; dispatch has no 5-before-send case, so it keeps its own convention.)

## Self-tests

| Script | Before (`e7354255`) | After |
|---|---|---|
| `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --self-test` | 331 cases / 28 batteries | 349 / 29 (new battery: 18 cases; battery floor 28 → 29) |
| `label-write.mjs --self-test` | 165 / 13 | 171 / 13 (ONE-OF battery 6 → 8, kind battery 21 → 25) |
| `fleet-write/validate.mjs --self-test` | 340 / 17 | 340 / 17 (unchanged file) |
| `fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test` | 284 / 24 | 284 / 24 (unchanged file) |

Cases per door and direction:

- `pr_create` + state: pure and CLI (usage 2, zero reads, no payload).
- `issue_create` + `pm:awaiting-merge`: pure, and CLI in mixed case.
- `labels_add` + state on a target that reads as a PR: CLI, one GET, usage 2.
- `labels_add` + `pm:awaiting-merge` on a target that reads as an issue: CLI, usage 2.
- Mixed case: `Needs-User-Decision` on `pr_create` and on `labels_add`; `PM:Awaiting-Merge` on `issue_create`. In label-write: a state in mixed case on a PR, `PM:Awaiting-Merge` on an issue, and two states in mixed case in `refuseTwoStates`.
- Removal never refused: `labels_remove` in dispatch (zero reads, exit 0), and a mixed-case `--remove` in label-write.
- Unreadable kind on `labels_add`: 503 gives exit 3 with the rule quoted; disagreeing members are refused; no answer is unread; no token gives exit 3 with zero requests.
- Whole file: a real (not dry) run with a legal `comment` beside a refused `labels_add` sends zero requests.
- Controls: each label on its own kind passes; mixed case does not widen the rule.

## Ablations

Run with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each one plants the old behaviour, runs the self-test, and restores; the tool proves blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD` after each.

| # | File · predicate planted back | Self-test | Red cases |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | label-write · `refuseTwoStates` exact match (`(target ?? []).includes(l)`) | 1 of 171 red | ⭐ a state spelled in another case IS that state … so two are still REFUSED |
| A2 | label-write · kind refusal exact match (`new Set(adds)`) | 2 of 171 red | ⭐ a state in MIXED CASE on a PULL REQUEST is refused like the lower-case name; ⭐ `pm:awaiting-merge` in MIXED CASE on an ISSUE is refused the same way |
| A3 | dispatch · creates know no kind (`const kind = null`) | 6 of 349 red | ⭐ a pm state in pr_create's labels is refused with no read; ⭐ pm:awaiting-merge in issue_create's labels is refused with no read; ⭐ MIXED CASE at each create; control (creates fall to the read list); ⭐ CLI: pr_create with a state; ⭐ CLI: issue_create with pm:awaiting-merge in MIXED CASE |
| A4 | dispatch · no `labels_add` read (`labelReads = []`) | 7 of 349 red | ⭐ CLI labels_add state on a PR; ⭐ `Needs-User-Decision` on a PR; ⭐ pm:awaiting-merge on an issue; ⭐ UNREADABLE kind; a state on an issue packs (one GET); ⭐ a refusal sends NOTHING for the whole file; …with no token exit 3 |
| A5 | dispatch · an unread kind passes (`verdict: 'pass'`) | 2 of 349 red | ⛔ a 503 and no answer are UNREAD; ⭐ CLI: an UNREADABLE kind on labels_add is PREREQUISITE NOT MET (3) |

Blobs: label-write `ec6ce829a64f` (A1 → `fa3a509bae1c`, A2 → `b6a6e1353123`); dispatch `0654a387bd57` (A3 → `707c50666b29`, A4 → `60dd7d002198`, A5 → `93812d8188ee`). Each was restored to its HEAD blob.

## open_questions

1. **Tier.** The order expects Tier S for `scripts/pm/**`. `check-governed-merges --test` on the two paths reads "NOT governed — ordinary queue landing" (0 of 13 surfaces hit). The PR body reports the measured reading; the seat decides how it lands.
2. **Other doors.** `issue-create.mjs` and `close-cards.mjs` send through `sendFleetWrite` directly, not through `dispatch.mjs`'s `main`, so this check does not cover them. They were outside the file surface. `issue-create.mjs` can put labels on a new issue, but only `pm:awaiting-merge` is illegal on an issue. Say if a follow-up card is wanted.
